rawContent: City Council spent all summer co-opting the phrase “reimagining public safety” as they rhetorically embraced alternatives to police in response to #BlackLivesMatter protests. This motion would criminalize a disproportionately Black population. #HousekeysNotHandcuffs

Unhoused people are arrested at 17x the rate as the overall population in LA. 1 in 3 incidences of ‘use of force’ by LAPD is against an unhoused person. 40% of unhoused Angelenos are Black. You can’t believe #BlackLivesMatter and also support this motion. #housekeysnothandcuffs
